## Core Specializations

- [Web & E-Commerce Development](https://www.waseemakram.dev/#services): High-performance websites, custom web apps, and modern e-commerce storefronts built with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- [SaaS Platform Architecture](https://www.waseemakram.dev/#services): Scalable SaaS systems, microservices, multi-tenant databases, real-time dashboards, and robust API development from MVP to enterprise scale.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.waseemakram.dev/#services): Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android built with React Native and modern native interfaces.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Lenis.
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, NestJS, Express, GraphQL, REST APIs.
- Databases & Cloud: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Firebase, Supabase, Docker.

## Engineering Process

An end-to-end 8-step product delivery workflow:
1. Discovery — Clear vision and requirement mapping
2. Research — Target audience and technical feasibility
3. Strategy — Architectural blueprint and roadmap
4. Design — Wireframing, UX journeys, and interactive design
5. Development — Clean, maintainable full-stack implementation
6. Integration — Third-party APIs, databases, payment gateways, and cloud infrastructure
7. Refinement — Testing, performance tuning, and accessibility optimization
8. Launch — Production deployment, monitoring, and seamless handover

## Portfolio Case Studies

- [All Projects Archive](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects): Browse all 7 engineering & design case studies.
- [Azad Concrete ERP](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects/azad-concrete-erp): Full-stack manufacturing ERP, raw material BOM inventory, PDF gatepasses, and double-entry accounting ledger built with Next.js & PostgreSQL.
- [Relayvo](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects/relayvo): B2B SaaS operations platform connecting team handoffs, telemetry analytics, and motion-choreographed workflows.
- [Monivo](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects/monivo): Dark-mode collaborative SaaS workspace combining editorial typography with modular product views.
- [Veyra Studio](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects/veyra-studio): Kinetic typography & multi-route digital agency platform powered by Next.js, GSAP, and Lenis.
- [Nortera Advisory](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects/nortera-advisory): Financial & corporate strategy advisory platform built around institutional clarity.
- [Avenor](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects/avenor): Architectural studio flagship blending charcoal dark galleries, warm terracotta panels, and spatial studies.
- [Orvane Studio](https://www.waseemakram.dev/projects/orvane-studio): Slate-and-ice spatial design portfolio showcasing residential & interior case studies.
